teta.translation: [医][=triethylene-tetramine polystyrene resin]三亚乙基四胺聚苯乙烯树脂，三乙撑四胺聚苯乙烯树脂

tetanic.definition:
a. of or relating to or causing tetany
a. of or relating to or causing tetanus
tetanic.translation:
a. 破伤风的, 强直性的
n. 强直剂

tetanic spasm.translation: [医] 破伤风痉挛; 强直性痉挛, 紧张性痉挛

tetaniform.translation: [医] 破伤风样的; 强直样的

tetanigenous.translation: [医] 引起破伤风的; 致强直的

tetanilla.definition: n clinical neurological syndrome characterized by muscular twitching and cramps and (when severe) seizures; associated with calcium deficiency (hypoparathyroidism) or vitamin D deficiency or alkalosis
tetanilla.translation: [医] 无强直手足搐搦; 多发性肌阵挛

tetanin.definition:
n. A poisonous base (ptomaine) formed in meat broth through
   the agency of a peculiar microbe from the wound of a person who has
   died of tetanus; -- so called because it produces tetanus as one of its
   prominent effects.

tetanine.translation: 破伤风菌毒素, 破伤风宁, 破伤风精蛋白

tetanism.translation: [医] 破伤风样病, 假破伤风

tetanization.definition: n. The production or condition of tetanus.

tetanize.definition:
v. t. To throw, as a muscle, into a state of permanent
   contraction; to cause tetanus in. See Tetanus, n., 2.
tetanize.translation:
vt. 使强直
[医] 促强直, 致强直

tetanoid.translation: 破伤风状的, 强直样的

tetanoid chorea.translation: [医] 手足搐搦样舞蹈病, 进行性豆状核变性

tetanoid fever.translation: [医] 破伤风样热, 脑脊膜炎

tetanomotor.definition:
n. An instrument from tetanizing a muscle by irritating
   its nerve by successive mechanical shocks.

tetanus.definition:
n. an acute and serious infection of the central nervous system caused by bacterial infection of open wounds; spasms of the jaw and laryngeal muscles may occur during the late stages
n. a sustained muscular contraction resulting from a rapid series of nerve impulses
tetanus.translation:
n. 破伤风
[医] 破伤风; 强直

tetanus nascentium.translation: [医] 新生儿破伤风, 脐风

tetanus paradoxus.translation: [医] 奇异破伤风, 头部破伤风

tetanus perfringens antitoxin.translation: [医] 破伤风气性坏疽抗毒素

tetanus rheumaticus.translation: [医] 风湿性破伤风, 自发性破伤风

tetanus toxin.translation:
[化] 破伤风毒素
[医] 破伤风毒素

tetany.definition: n clinical neurological syndrome characterized by muscular twitching and cramps and (when severe) seizures; associated with calcium deficiency (hypoparathyroidism) or vitamin D deficiency or alkalosis

tetarcaoid.translation: [医] 下后内尖, 下颌双尖牙后内尖

tetarcone.translation: (=tetartocone)上后内尖, 上颌双尖牙后内尖

tetard.definition:
n. A gobioid fish (Eleotris gyrinus) of the Southern United
   States; -- called also sleeper.

tetartanope.translation: 象限盲者; 蓝黄色盲者

tetartanopia.definition: n a form of dichromacy characterized by lowered sensitivity to yellow light; so rare that its existence has been questioned
tetartanopia.translation: 象限盲, 四分之一盲

tetartocone.translation: [医] 上后内尖, 上颔双尖牙后内尖

tetartoconid.translation: [医] 下后内尖, 下颔双尖牙后内尖

tetartohedral.definition:
a. Having one fourth the number of planes which are
   requisite to complete symmetry.
tetartohedral.translation: a. 具有四分之一结晶体对称面的

tetartohedrism.definition: n. The property of being tetartohedral.
